title: 'La feria de Sevilla' in Sevilla, Spain
Winter Theme Park, Ukraine
contributor: Participant 08: Fancy themed park in the winter around Christmas. Shops, Christmas tree and ferris wheel. It's one of my favourite places in Kharkiv (Central park of culture and recreation named after M Gorky)
description: Prompt: fancy themed park. winter. fairy lights. people walking. square with a big christmas tree in the middle. big ferris wheel. big stage for performing. shops stationed around the christmas tree. attractions in the distance. alleys with trees and benches.
